_comment: First-class boards for the compile/upload workflow.
A board is a part plus the memory, compiler flags, and programmer that
a minimum board of that part actually has -- not the family maximum.
AT89S52 on a DIP-40 with no external RAM is model-small and xram 0;
the NiusDisplay graphics demos need SRAM fitted and --xram-size.

at89s52.note: 8 KB flash, 256 IRAM, no XRAM on a minimum DIP-40. USB-ISP HID. Segment/TM1637 sketches fit; colour graphics need external SRAM.

at89s51.note: 4 KB flash. Same USB-ISP HID route as AT89S52.

at89c2051.note: 2 KB flash. No ISP: 12 V parallel programmer on a Nano. compile works; upload is not yet wired.

stc89c52rc.note: UART bootloader (stcgal), not SPI ISP. Same DIP-40 as AT89S52 is a different protocol.
